messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] SLO breach on /v1/streaming/generate (us-west-2) — window=3m, p95 1.4s -> 3.8s, p99 2.8s -> 9.6s. Streaming stalls increased (120 -> 560). KV cache eviction spike detected on shard-17. Pager: @oncall-sre

maria: paging oncall — I'm up, looking now. which shard?

aj: oncall-sre here. grabbing dashboards. tagging @sahil for KV metrics and @olivia for streaming traces.

sahil: seeing big spike on `kv_prefill_eviction_rate` for shard-17 starting ~1719999900; rate x8 vs baseline. `prefill_queue_len` jumped 850 -> 2400. slab_free_frag fraction down 6% -> 0.3%. correlates with decode latency spikes.

olivia: trace samples show stalls during decode where we see repeated prefill churn: prefill populates KV entries then eviction immediately reclaims them while decode waits -> long tail. Example trace id: trace-0a1b2c.

leo: I can disable prefill on the shard via internal control plane. command: `curl -XPOST https://api-internal/control/shard/17/prefill/disable -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>'` — ok to run?

aj: do it. also start gradual reroute of 15% traffic to us-west-1 for `model:v2-small` to reduce pressure. ops command: `./ops/reroute --from us-west-2 --to us-west-1 --percent 15 --model v2-small`

maria: CS heads up: @caitlin please pull impacted customer list, priority customers first. telemetry shows ~12 orgs had >30s stalls in last 10m; 3 are tagged as critical.

caitlin: pulling list, drafting customer message. will DM legal for any contractual escalations.

aj: mitigation timeline: prefill disabled on shard-17 at 1720006920; reroute started at 1720006950 (15% to us-west-1 v2-small). restarting prefill workers for shard-17 to purge any bad state: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/prefill-workers -n inference -l shard=17`

sahil: restart finished ~1720007005. immediate telemetry: p95 dropped to ~1.7s, p99 to ~3.2s, stalled streams from 560 -> 180 over 6m. partial recovery but tail still elevated.

olivia: streaming observations: after prefill shutdown we still see occasional stalls tied to eviction thrash during larger decode batches. hypothesis: slab fragmentation + many small allocations from recent prefill bursts cause eviction churn when decode tries to populate large KV frames.

leo: I can run a slab compaction job: `python tools/slab_compactor.py --shard 17 --max-delta 30` — recommends running in low-traffic window. we have reduced traffic via reroute; want me to start now?

aj: wait ~15m to let reroute stabilize and for prefill-free decode behavior to settle. in the meantime set eviction policy soft to prefer keeping decode entries:

POST /internal/shard/17/eviction_policy
{ "mode": "soft_prefill_hold" }

(ops executed at 1720007048)

maria: CS update sent to affected customers, included mitigations and ETA for deeper fix. one customer requested logs and timeline — @caitlin sent initial summary.

caitlin: customers acknowledged. one asked about SLA credit; I escalated to account team.

aj: adding live evidence snippet (eviction log + latency lines):

```
[1720006901] shard=17 kv_eviction event=evict key=pf:hot:abcd size=2.4KB cause=prefill
[1720006901] shard=17 latency decode=23ms prefill=120ms post-evict-wait=4800ms stream=stalled
[1720006905] shard=17 kv_eviction event=evict key=dec:session:xyz size=48KB cause=slab_reclaim
[1720006910] shard=17 latency decode=18ms prefill=130ms post-evict-wait=5200ms stream=stalled
```

aj: next steps / owners:
- leo: schedule and run slab compaction on shard-17 (owner: leo)
- sahil: add a dedicated alert for prefill vs decode imbalance and track `prefill_queue_len` + `eviction_rate` correlation (owner: sahil)
- maria: incident postmortem and customer follow-up (owner: maria)
- aj: create incident ticket and link runbook changes (owner: aj)

maria: handing monitoring to olivia for next 45m. I'll stay available for customer comms.

\olivia: I'll monitor dashboards and will escalate if p99 > 4s or stalled streams > 200 for 10m. next update at +30m.

aj: creating Jira INC-1720 and assigning owners. please paste any extra traces there.

leo: scheduling slab compaction for 1720007800 (low traffic). will post start/stop times.

sahil: note for postmortem: consider adding adaptive prefill rate limiter that respects current slab_free_frag and eviction_rate; also consider soft-hold policy by default for decode-critical keys.

maria: thanks team. summary: immediate mitigations (prefill disabled, partial traffic reroute, eviction policy soft), visible recovery but follow-ups required (slab compaction, alerts, runbook updates, customer outreach). handing off to olivia for live watch. sign-off. :white_check_mark:
